name: Antwerp Six
summary: Their movement was a radical reaction against the opulent, maximalist trends dominating the 1980s fashion landscape, such as American Power Dressing .
description: Their movement was a radical reaction against the opulent, maximalist trends dominating the 1980s fashion landscape, such as American Power Dressing . Their shared philosophy emphasized intellectualism, craftsmanship, and a severe, often dark, aesthetic that placed Antwerp on the global fashion map. [ 3 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Avant-garde, anti-fashion, intellectualism, craftsmanship, individuality, non-conformity

visualDNA.colour: Black, charcoal grey, off-white, muted earth tones (for deconstructive designers); saturated prints, bright colors (for Dries Van Noten/Walter Van Beirendonck)
